proof_scope: Tau provider-live packaged workflow acceptance proof and fail-closed verifier

claims.proves: Tau can build a fresh wheel, run the installed public tau entrypoint through all five packaged workflows, exercise the configured provider boundary, bind the receipt to source commit and wheel digest, and reject tampered provider-live proof.
claims.does_not_prove: Provider semantic quality, human acceptance, production deployment readiness, or Tau GOAL.md completion.

what_was_exercised: local commands declared in the fixture manifest
what_remains_unverified: semantic correctness, live services, LLM judge behavior, and release readiness

claims.description: Tau exposes one-command provider-live packaged workflow acceptance proof and verification commands that fail closed on tampered provider evidence.

cases.name: provider-live-five-packaged-workflows-installed-entrypoint
argv: cd .. && rm -rf .tmp/agentic-evals/provider-live-acceptance && mkdir -p .tmp/agentic-evals/provider-live-acceptance && uv run tau workflows acceptance-proof --repo . --output .tmp/agentic-evals/provider-live-acceptance/receipt.json --work-dir .tmp/agentic-evals/provider-live-acceptance/work --provider-url http://127.0.0.1:4001 --timeout-s 5 && uv run tau workflows verify-acceptance-proof .tmp/agentic-evals/provider-live-acceptance/receipt.json --repo .
